Vendored byte for byte from flux/defxn-defi-rs/dense-wire/web/ (branch fix/one-name-system,
worktree flux/defxn-defi-rs-wt-names until it merges). Never edit a file here: fix it at the
source and copy it over. A drift test in this repo fails when any file differs from the source.

Files: flx-domain-proof.mjs (the ONE shared DOM_PROOF verifier), and the files it imports:
flx-dumb-parser.mjs, flx-builders.mjs, flx-crypto.mjs; plus flx-wire.mjs (the WebSocket line
protocol client whose domProof() asks a node).
